children: While surging Treasury yields rattled traditional risk assets, Bitcoin held its ground near $84,000 and select altcoins pushed higher, with ONDO emerging as the session's standout performer.

S&P Global's September flash composite PMI came in at 58.4, the strongest reading since July 2021. A number above 50 signals expansion; a number this far above 50 signals the kind of economic momentum that makes central bankers reach for the hawkish playbook.
Bond markets responded exactly as you'd expect. The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield climbed to approximately 5.11%, a level not seen since 2007.

Bitcoin traded in a range between roughly $83,200 and $87,000 during the session, absorbing the macro turbulence without breaking down through what the market had established as a key support zone. The broader crypto market cap did see 2-3% fluctuations.
Among altcoins, ONDO was the name that kept appearing in the session recap. The token traded between $0.42 and $0.50, posting gains while much of the altcoin market delivered mixed or flat results.
ONDO is the governance token of Ondo Finance, a protocol that has staked its identity on tokenized real-world assets, specifically U.S. Treasuries and equities.

Ondo Finance has been building out its product suite aggressively. The protocol has notched partnerships with NEAR and Alpaca, expanded its tokenized stock offerings, and secured a connection to DTCC, the U.S. clearing infrastructure backbone. BlackRock's broader push into tokenized assets has also created favorable ambient conditions for the entire sector.

The mixed altcoin performance during the session is worth unpacking. It wasn't a rising tide that lifted all boats. Bitcoin's relative stability provided a floor, but the gains were concentrated in tokens with identifiable institutional narratives rather than spreading evenly across the market.

The movements observed during this session appear primarily influenced by sector dynamics rather than any ONDO-specific catalysts, indicating a broader trend in altcoin performance when Bitcoin stabilizes around critical support levels.

title: ONDO leads altcoin surge as Bitcoin holds near $84,000
